title: Make a small object
summary: Ruby: Make a small object. Make a red badge.
introduction: A class groups data and methods. initialize runs when a new object is made.
learningObjectives: Make a small object with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.

blocks.title: Make a small object

blocks.text: initialize stores blue in @colour. The label method reads that object field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: @colour belongs to the object; colour is only a local input.
